title: Yoda and the Younglings
description: Yoda was perhaps the most remarkable Jedi Master who ever lived. He had mentored many great heroes over the long years, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker among them. But before and during the Clone Wars, Yoda seemed most content instructing numerous Younglings at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. His Lightsaber-wielding students came from many different planets, and all felt extremely privileged to be in learning sessions with this very special Jedi Master.
